timing_scope: encoder call only; input fingerprints/type counting/hashes outside ordinary timing
natural_gc_scope: interleaved encoder samples, their validation bookkeeping and optional traced section; setup/fresh solve/source archiving excluded

natural_gc.duration_scope: natural collection plus intervening callbacks; not exclusive collector cost

source_scope: All raw ordinary timing samples, natural GC observations and optional traced allocation samples retained. Type-count dictionaries deduplicated losslessly by canonical SHA.
